# anecdotes_mapping_requirement_evidence_scope (Resource)

Scopes evidence on a requirement to one framework or one control.

`anecdotes_mapping_requirement_evidence` links evidence to a requirement everywhere the
requirement is used. This resource adds the evidence within one framework or control only,
or with `excluded = true` removes it there.

An entry that already exists must be imported. A framework scope is stored only for a custom framework or a framework that is active in your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anecdotes_requirement" "access_review" {
  name        = "User access is reviewed quarterly"
  description = "Access rights are reviewed and approved every quarter"
  category    = "Access"
}

# The evidence counts for the requirement only within this framework.
resource "anecdotes_mapping_requirement_evidence_scope" "sox_access_review" {
  requirement_id = anecdotes_requirement.access_review.requirement_id
  evidence_id    = "evidence_12345"
  scope_id       = "framework_67890"
  scope_type     = "framework"
}

# Evidence linked to the requirement everywhere is left out of this control.
resource "anecdotes_mapping_requirement_evidence_scope" "exclude_from_control" {
  requirement_id = anecdotes_requirement.access_review.requirement_id
  evidence_id    = "evidence_54321"
  scope_id       = "control_55312"
  scope_type     = "control"
  excluded       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `evidence_id` (String) The unique identifier of the evidence item to scope.
- `requirement_id` (String) The unique identifier of the requirement.
- `scope_id` (String) The unique identifier of the framework or control the evidence is scoped to.
- `scope_type` (String) The kind of object `scope_id` refers to: `framework` or `control`.

### Optional

- `excluded` (Boolean) When `true`, the evidence is removed from the scope instead of added to it. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an evidence scope by requirement_id/scope_id/evidence_id.
terraform import anecdotes_mapping_requirement_evidence_scope.example requirement_12345/framework_67890/evidence_54321
```
